text:
Morgan: Kicking off a dry-run for the early-morning cutover. Plan to apply network + iam modules at 03:30 UTC. Release tag: release/2026-03-21. Proposing provider pin to `hashicorp/aws` 3.5.1 for canary - any objections?
Priya: noted the KMS key rotation in release notes — that'll touch the SA role. We should canary in staging first then prod.
Ken: +1 on pin to 3.5.1. Also set deploybot override=false for this change window.
DeployBot: [system] running `terraform plan` (workspace=prod) for modules: network, iam. Plan id: plan-3170004567.
Morgan: plan snippet (trimmed):
```
+ aws_kms_key.main (new)
~ aws_iam_role.service (update in-place -> replace?)
+ aws_nat_gateway.canary (no-op expected)
```
Iris: heads-up — if the plan wants to replace `aws_iam_role.service` we need manual approval. I can review at 03:15 UTC.
Priya: if anything replaces the nat gateway abort immediately. Also create rollback tag: `pre-apply-20260321` and snapshot tfstate.
Ken: agree. Canary only in eu-west-1, drain window 10m. Abort criteria: p50 latency > 200ms or error-rate > 0.5%.
SRE-Bot: created SLO monitor `release-20260321-canary` and routed alerts to #eng-oncall.
Morgan: locking the release branch now, will add an escape hatch: `terraform state pull` snapshot -> upload to s3://redwood-backups/pre-apply-20260321. Steps: 1) smoke in staging 02:45 2) run prod dry-run 03:00 3) apply canary in eu-west-1 03:30 4) observe 10m 5) promote or roll back.
Ben: :thumbsup:
Priya: I'll be on watch during the window. If manual approval needed ping @Iris and I'll hold the apply.
Morgan: thanks. Adding a short note to release notes: "Pin provider 3.5.1 for canary; KMS rotation requires staged rollout." Anyone else?
Ken: one more - add deploybot flag `--no-auto-rollback` false (i.e. allow auto-rollback on failures) so we don't hang.
Morgan: done. I'll kick the dry-run now and post the full plan output if anything weird shows up.
DeployBot: plan complete, no replacements for nat gateway. Full plan attached to build 3170004567-plan (link: https://ci.internal/plan/3170004567).
Iris: reading plan now. If it's clean I'll give manual thumbs-up at 03:20.
Morgan: perfect. leaving this thread as the single-source ops log for the window.
